events.name: Bash
events.head: Check task states, probe wiring, enrolment code

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find welcome enrolment event and probe usage
events.input: $ grep -rn "enrol" cloud/src --include=*.ts | grep -iE "event|welcome|record" | head -8; head -40 app/scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs | grep -nE "CENTRE|SIM|wrangler|local|usage" | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find enrolment code and probe setup header

events.name: Bash
events.head: See how the chain starts centre and sim
events.input: $ grep -nE "vendor-sim|wrangler|ADMIN=|SIM_URL|persist" app/scripts/run-chain.sh | head -15; lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -P | grep -E ":(8960|8882|8792|8787)" | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find dev/sim startup commands
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud && grep -nE "\"(dev|migrate|sim)[^\"]*\"" package.json; head -30 scripts/vendor-sim.py | grep -nE "port|PORT|usage|argv"; grep -nE "TANTRA_(URL|BASE|API)|tantraUrl" src/connectors/stack.ts | head -5; ls /tmp/rc-* 2>/dev/null | head

events.text: Checking how the centre routes Tantra calls to the simulator so I can run the probe on a private stack.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find sim routing and past run recipe
events.input: $ grep -nE "const (TN|isSim|SIM)|function (TN|isSim)|VENDOR_SIM|SIM_URL" src/connectors/stack.ts | head -8; grep -rnE "VENDOR_SIM|SIM_URL" wrangler.* .dev.vars.example 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -rn "private local centre\|--persist-to\|VENDOR_SIM" ../workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-228.json 2>/dev/null | head -3 | cut -c1-400

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start private vendor-sim and migrate a private local D1
events.input: $ P=/tmp/t228v-$$ && mkdir -p $P && echo $P > /tmp/t228v-dir && SIM_PORT=8893 SIM_STATE=$P/sim.json nohup python3 scripts/vendor-sim.py > $P/sim.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/t228v-sim.pid; sleep 0; cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud && P=$(cat /tmp/t228v-dir) && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply $(grep -m1 -E 'database_name' wrangler.* | sed -E 's/.*"([^"]+)".*/\1/') --local --persist-to $P/state 2>&1 | tail -2

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start private wrangler dev centre wired to the sim
events.input: $ P=$(cat /tmp/t228v-dir) && nohup npx wrangler dev --port 8961 --inspector-port 9341 --persist-to $P/state --var SIM_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8893 > $P/wr.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/t228v-wr.pid; for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:8961/ 2>/dev/null | grep -qE "^[1-5]" && break; python3 -c "import time;time.sleep(2)"; done; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "centre %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8961/; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "sim %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8893/; tail -3 $P/wr.log

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the Tantra reminders probe against the private stack
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app && CENTRE=http://127.0.0.1:8961 SIM=http://127.0.0.1:8893 node scripts/probe-tantra-reminders.mjs > /tmp/t228v-probe.log 2>&1; echo exit $?; grep -ciE "^\s*(ok|pass|✓)" /tmp/t228v-probe.log; grep -iE "fail|✗|not ok" /tmp/t228v-probe.log | head -8; tail -3 /tmp/t228v-probe.log
